note: The official 2025-26 syllabus applies to candidates admitted in 2025-26 and thereafter, subject to approval. The 96-credit First Major in International Business and Global Management comprises 24 Faculty Core credits, 60 credits from ten required Disciplinary Core courses and 12 Disciplinary Elective credits from one List A course and one List B course. The separate 72-credit or greater Second Major is open to any discipline offered by FBE or HKU and is not expanded into the Programme-local IBGM pool. Language, Common Core, AI literacy, non-credit University requirements and free electives are excluded because they contain open or placeholder course ranges. The compulsory overseas exchange is retained in the evidence note but has no prescribed HKU course code. Courses are not necessarily offered every year.
